title: Glass-Supplier Delay Notices and the Share of On-Time Credit
content:
**Note.** For Factory Production Orders, a glass-supplier share is applied to the on-time guarantee credit by the glass-supplier delay notices on the order:

| Glass-supplier delay notices on the order | Share of the credit left |
|---|---|
| two or more | 80 percent |
| exactly one | 90 percent |
| none | the full credit |

The share is applied to the amount formed from the weekly credit rate, the units on the order and the credited weeks; the class cap per order is applied after the share, and the credit is rounded to the cent once, at the end.

## Records read

Delay notices with cause glass supplier on the order's milestone records, each counting once.

## Hypothetical examples

| Amount before the share | Notices | After the share | Class cap | Credit |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 200.00 | 1 | 180.00 | 250.00 | 180.00 |
| 400.00 | 2 | 320.00 | 250.00 | 250.00 |
| 300.00 | 2 | 240.00 | 250.00 | 240.00 |
| 150.00 | 0 | 150.00 | 250.00 | 150.00 |

The third row shows the order of the two steps: 300.00 reduced to 240.00 by the share is under the 250.00 cap and is credited in full.
